hint.text: While all plants have the same basic needs, some need more or less of certain things depending on their species and habitat.

atoms.b: This is a forest of ((coniferous --deciduous)) trees. Most conifers grow throughout the whole year, even during snowy ((winters --summers)). Many species of conifer grow in the Northern Hemisphere where there may be less ((sunlight --wind)) and the temperature gets much ((colder --hotter)). Conifers have also adapted to be able to live in ((dry --wet)) conditions.

instruction.text: Based on the text, where do most coniferous trees like to grow?

atoms.b: This ((++cactus sunflower)) is a special plant called a succulent. Succulents are able to store a large amount of ((water --seeds)) within themselves in order to survive very ((hot_and_dry --cold_and_wet)) conditions. They can survive long periods of time without ((water --sun)), which makes them great houseplants. Many succulents, like this cactus, are covered in ((needles --leaves)). The needles prevent too much water from being evaporated by the ((heat --ground)).
